concept_options.title: What If You Could Pause Time for 10 Seconds a Day?
concept_options.hook: You wake up and discover you can pause time. Ten seconds. Once a day.
concept_options.visual_approach: Frozen grey street, you mid-sprint in colour, counter at 7
concept_options.why_this_works: The owner's question; the stakes are in the frame

concept_options.title: What Can You Really Do in 10 Frozen Seconds?
concept_options.hook: Your coffee is falling. You have ten seconds nobody else gets.
concept_options.visual_approach: Grey kitchen, you catching the mug; tag DAY 1
concept_options.why_this_works: Leads with the practical question the facts answer

concept_options.title: What If Time Stopped for 10 Seconds, but Not for You?
concept_options.hook: Everything stops. Then someone else moves.
concept_options.visual_approach: Frozen crowd, one crimson stranger walking; tag WHO MOVED?
concept_options.why_this_works: Strongest mystery, but shows the ending

selected_concept.rationale: Agent's recommendation; the owner picks at G1. The owner's own question, with the counter as the thumbnail's only text.
